source: Authored RegExp suite; original omoikane eleven unchanged

workloads.name: regexp-construction
workloads.oracle: 128 matches, each full match length 8 plus captures of lengths 5 and 2: 128*15=1920. Pattern text varies; construction may use engine caches.

workloads.name: regexp-global-exec
workloads.oracle: Three matches of lengths 3,4,2 give 9*2048=18432. A failed exec terminates each scan and resets global state; a final non-match is checked.

workloads.name: regexp-unicode-captures
workloads.oracle: 1024 astral matches contribute 2+2 UTF-16 units; 1024 ASCII matches contribute 1+1: 1024*6=6144.
